solution_text: Using the lens relation 1/f = 1/v - 1/u with f = 20 cm and u = -40 cm gives 1/v = 1/20 - 1/40 = 1/40, so v = 40 cm.
tips: Use the Cartesian sign convention consistently in lens problems.
